operations.name: _tests
operations.description:
dbt tests and constraints of the columns: unique, not_null, accepted_values. dbt checks them at
each build, so they are facts about the table.

operations.name: table
operations.description: The table of a `ref` or a `source`: a model that runs, or a table with a schema only.

operations.name: narrowed
operations.description: The column after rows were removed: equal sets become subsets.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Rows of a table, as a grid shows them.

classes.name: Grid

operations.name: slot
operations.description: Centre of the cell at row `r` and column position `j`, also for a cell that does not exist.

operations.name: commit_rows
operations.description: Renumber the rows after row perm[j] moved to position j.

classes.description: A table drawn as cells of equal size. Row -1 is the header row.

classes.name: Card

operations.name: set_state
operations.description: input: read by the step; output: made by the step; idle: in scope; dead: no later step reads it.

classes.description: One table on the tables shelf: name, shape, and a mini table of its first rows.

classes.name: DebuggerScene

operations.name: __init__
operations.description: facts: the facts of each table op, derived from a larger trace. A dbt model renders only its own steps, but the facts of its inputs come from the models upstream of it. None: derive the facts from `steps`.

operations.name: play
operations.description: Skips a play with no animation (manim raises on it); approved in the test review of the union defect.

operations.name: _dag
operations.description:
The program graph, bottom left: source tables → calls → the tables that each call hands on → the calls
that read them → the result. The call of step i is lit, with the names of the tables on its arrows in; the
calls that ran are green.

operations.name: _trace_lines
operations.description:
(kind, step, text, depth): a line per call with the tables that it reads, a line per step under it, and a
"return" line per table that the call hands on, with the calls that read it (`→ stg_stores to usa_stores()`).

operations.name: _trace
operations.description: The trace around step i: the steps that ran, the current step, and the steps to come.

operations.name: _strip
operations.description: The statement as a pipeline: source → each call of the chain → result, with the current call lit.

operations.name: _code_block
operations.description: The place of the statement (`file.py:12`) and its display lines, wrapped to the width of the bar.

operations.name: _layout
operations.description: Each line of the statement of step i after the first moves the trace, the pipeline and the stage down.

operations.name: _header
operations.description: Top bar: step, operation, call path and the current statement. Left: the trace. Middle: the pipeline.

operations.name: _activate
operations.description: New tables join the shelf; the step's inputs light up and grow; the others dim.

operations.name: _named
operations.description: Grid titles: the variable of the code for an input, else the name of its table (`filtered orders`).

operations.name: _guarantees
operations.description: What the step guarantees about its result, then its warnings.

operations.name: _enter
operations.description:
Each input table grows out of its card on the shelf. In a chain, the table already on the stage
moves into place instead.

operations.name: _morph
operations.description:
Hand a table from one layout to the next: each column and each row moves to its new place.

A cell moves to the cell of the same column and the same row (rows are matched by their values).
Cells of columns or rows that the new layout does not show leave first; new cells arrive last.

operations.name: _finish
operations.description:
The result shrinks into its card; replaced and expired cards leave; the shelf closes up.

When the next step works on the result (a chain, or `t = t.filter(...)` then `t.mutate(...)`), the result
stays on the stage for it, and its card appears on the shelf without the result moving there.

operations.name: _say
operations.description: Show the caption of the current phase under the pipeline.

operations.name: _settle
operations.description: Keep only the debugger frame, the caption and `keep` on the screen.

operations.name: _in_place
operations.description: Draw the grids on top of each other, with the same top-left cell. `margin` is room on the right.

operations.name: _fly
operations.description: Copies of the source cells move into the target cells. Each group of pairs moves together.

operations.name: _drop
operations.description: Fade `parts` out and take their cells out of `grid`. FadeOut alone restores the mobject at the end.

operations.name: _reorder
operations.description: Move row perm[j] to position j along an arc, so that the rows visibly change places.

operations.name: _sort_arrow
operations.description: A vertical arrow right of the grid, with the sort keys and their direction.

operations.name: _flow
operations.description: Fallback: each output column comes from the input column with the same name.

operations.name: _subset
operations.description:
Each row gets a mark when there is a test; removed rows turn red and leave; the others slide up.

`condition` is a filter label (see `_condition`): it stays at the right of the ✔/✘ marks.

operations.name: _show_condition
operations.description: Put the filter label at `left`, level with the rows, and fit it into the stage.

operations.name: _tests
operations.description: Each test gets a column of ✔/✘. Then, per row, the marks merge into the result (AND / OR).

operations.name: _distinct
operations.description: Take each row in turn; scan the rows below it; the duplicates turn red and leave; go to the next row.

operations.name: _fill_null
operations.description: Null cells light up red, then take the replacement value.

operations.name: _set_op
operations.description: Union appends the rows of the second table; intersect and difference test each row.

operations.name: _compare_rows
operations.description:
Intersect and difference compare whole rows: all the columns, not some of them.

Each row of the first table looks for a row of the second one with the same values in every
column: a solid line joins equal rows. When the nearest row shares only some values, a dashed
line points to it and the cells that differ turn red: such a row does not count.

operations.name: _retitle
operations.description: An in-place step keeps drawing its input table: at the end, its title names the result.

operations.name: _refresh_facts
operations.description: An in-place step keeps drawing its input table: at the end, its facts row takes the facts of the result.

operations.name: _subset_marks
operations.description:
Optional ✔/✘ marks; the rows to remove turn red and leave; the other rows slide up.

`extra` gives, for each row, mobjects (test marks) that move and leave with the row.

operations.name: _unnest
operations.description: Each array cell splits into its elements, and each element gets its own row.

operations.name: _order_by
operations.description: Highlight the sort keys, draw their direction, and move each row to its new position.

operations.name: _columns
operations.description: Carried columns keep or change place; per row, the source cells merge into each new cell.

operations.name: _insert
operations.description: A column built earlier slides into the table: each of its cells moves to the cell of its row.

operations.name: _coalesce
operations.description:
ibis.coalesce: per row, a pointer tries the values in the order of the arguments; a null sends it to
the next value; the first value that is not null moves into the new cell.

operations.name: _arrange_columns
operations.description: Move the columns of `grid` into `order`, along arcs, so that the moves are easy to follow.

operations.name: _ifelse
operations.description: ibis.ifelse: each row tests the condition; the value of the chosen branch moves into the new cell.

operations.name: _window
operations.description: Colour the partitions, sort the rows, then slide the window frame down the rows.

operations.name: _aggregate
operations.description: Colour the rows by group, gather each group, then collapse each group into one row.

operations.name: _join
operations.description: Move the keys to the inner edges, bring the tables together, line up the rows, merge the keys.

operations.name: _pivot_wider
operations.description: Distinct names become columns, the other columns become rows, values move to their cell.

operations.name: _pivot_longer
operations.description: For each input row, the cells of the pivoted columns rotate into a column of the result.

classes.description:
A debugger view: the trace on the left, the current statement on top, the step in the middle,
and the tables in scope on a shelf at the bottom.

classes.name: ScopeFrame
classes.description: The panel around one step. Each key is an op.

classes.name: Call
classes.description: A run of steps in one function call, or in the code of a module: a node of the program graph.

classes.name: Step
classes.description: One ibis operation, as the visual debugger shows it.
